source_revision: The commit containing this evidence directory

minio.build: go install github.com/minio/minio@v0.0.0-20250907161309-07c3a429bfed; built locally from pinned official source, not a release binary

environment.proxy_scope: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY removed case-insensitively from the command subprocess environment only; global configuration unchanged

scope: Single-domain authoritative CloseSubtaskBudget with immutable once-only cost rollup/unused return, child account sealing, durable ancestry-checked cancellation propagation through outboxd, no UNKNOWN hold release, terminal intermediaries, nested/zero-budget closeout, concurrent creation/cancellation and four real process-termination windows. Complete contract/VERIFIED validation, UpdateTaskStatus, SDK Gateway subtask signing, recipient-policy management, token exchange and cross-domain execution/settlement remain pending. Repeated benchmark covers existing root control paths, not closeout/propagation latency or production capacity.
development_note: Initial targeted run exposed invalid ON CONFLICT(dedup_key) in the new cancellation worker (outbox has no such unique constraint) and two nested test grant expiries on the nanosecond/microsecond storage boundary. The worker now relies on task-lock/terminal-state serialization; nested fixtures use an expiry strictly within the persisted parent interval. Corrected targeted tests passed. First full run passed all business assertions but failed TestIdentityDaemonProcess TempDir cleanup on instancekey.exe sharing violation. No instancekey process was observed; a DELETE-access probe first returned winerror 32 and subsequently succeeded without deleting the file. Test cleanup now retries only Windows sharing violation 32 for at most five seconds after CombinedOutput has waited for exit. It never retries commands or assertions and fails on timeout/other errors. Updated sources were frozen and the complete fresh-cluster suite passed all 40 gates, including MinIO and microbenchmark. All clusters were stopped.
